\section[(dialogue)]{Time and this and that — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R88-first-pass-time-and-this-and-that}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a cinema and a museum.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item noon, the day before yesterday, tonight, last night, time
  \item spring, summer, autumn, winter, a season
  \item Saturday, Sunday, Monday, Wednesday, Thursday
  \item now, never, this, that, these
  \item those, this very, that very, such, every
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Noon? (\textbf{\fa{ظهر}}, \emph{zohr}.) The day before yesterday? (\textbf{\fa{پریروز}}, \emph{pariruz}.) Tonight? (\textbf{\fa{امشب}}, \emph{emshab}.) Last night? (\textbf{\fa{دیشب}}, \emph{dishab}.) Time? (\textbf{\fa{زمان}}, \emph{zamân}.) Spring? (\textbf{\fa{بهار}}, \emph{bahâr}.) Summer? (\textbf{\fa{تابستان}}, \emph{tâbestân}.) Autumn? (\textbf{\fa{پاییز}}, \emph{pâyiz}.) Winter? (\textbf{\fa{زمستان}}, \emph{zemestân}.) A season? (\textbf{\fa{فصل}}, \emph{fasl}.) Saturday? (\textbf{\fa{شنبه}}, \emph{shanbe}.) Sunday? (\textbf{\fa{یکشنبه}}, \emph{yekshanbe}.) Monday? (\textbf{\fa{دوشنبه}}, \emph{doshanbe}.) Wednesday? (\textbf{\fa{چهارشنبه}}, \emph{chahârshanbe}.) Thursday? (\textbf{\fa{پنجشنبه}}, \emph{panjshanbe}.) Now? (\textbf{\fa{اکنون}}, \emph{aknun}.) Never? (\textbf{\fa{هرگز}}, \emph{hargez}.) This? (\textbf{\fa{این}}, \emph{in}.) That? (\textbf{\fa{آن}}, \emph{ân}.) These? (\textbf{\fa{اینها}}, \emph{inhâ}.) Those? (\textbf{\fa{آنها}}, \emph{ânhâ}.) This very? (\textbf{\fa{همین}}, \emph{hamin}.) That very? (\textbf{\fa{همان}}, \emph{hamân}.) Such? (\textbf{\fa{چنین}}, \emph{chenin}.) Every? (\textbf{\fa{هر}}, \emph{har}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{This and that, and places — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R88-second-pass-this-and-that-and-places}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for all and someone.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item all, someone, something, none, oneself
  \item which?, where?, beside, the middle, under
  \item on, between, a direction, a side, a corner
  \item a lane, a square, a park, a coast, a church
  \item a library, a pharmacy, a bakery, a cinema, a museum
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
All? (\textbf{\fa{همه}}, \emph{hame}.) Someone? (\textbf{\fa{کسی}}, \emph{kasi}.) Something? (\textbf{\fa{چیزی}}, \emph{chizi}.) None? (\textbf{\fa{هیچ}}, \emph{hich}.) Oneself? (\textbf{\fa{خود}}, \emph{khod}.) Asking which? (\textbf{\fa{کدام}}, \emph{kodâm}.) Asking where? (\textbf{\fa{کجا}}, \emph{kojâ}.) Beside? (\textbf{\fa{کنار}}, \emph{kenâr}.) The middle? (\textbf{\fa{وسط}}, \emph{vasat}.) Under? (\textbf{\fa{زیر}}, \emph{zir}.) On? (\textbf{\fa{روی}}, \emph{ruye}.) Between? (\textbf{\fa{بین}}, \emph{beyn}.) A direction? (\textbf{\fa{سمت}}, \emph{samt}.) A side? (\textbf{\fa{طرف}}, \emph{taraf}.) A corner? (\textbf{\fa{گوشه}}, \emph{gushe}.) A lane? (\textbf{\fa{کوچه}}, \emph{kuche}.) A square? (\textbf{\fa{میدان}}, \emph{meydân}.) A park? (\textbf{\fa{پارک}}, \emph{pârk}.) A coast? (\textbf{\fa{ساحل}}, \emph{sâhel}.) A church? (\textbf{\fa{کلیسا}}, \emph{kelisâ}.) A library? (\textbf{\fa{کتابخانه}}, \emph{ketâbkhâne}.) A pharmacy? (\textbf{\fa{داروخانه}}, \emph{dârukhâne}.) A bakery? (\textbf{\fa{نانوایی}}, \emph{nânvâyi}.) A cinema? (\textbf{\fa{سینما}}, \emph{sinemâ}.) A museum? (\textbf{\fa{موزه}}, \emph{muze}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
